caption: The drawing depicts an oval-shaped object, possibly a footstool, set against a plain, beige background. The main body of the object is a dark green color and features a floral pattern in its central area. The floral motif consists of a cluster of flowers and leaves in red, yellow, and light blue hues, with the stems rendered in yellow and green. The object stands on two short, brown, rounded legs, visible at the bottom edge. The texture of the object is rendered to resemble fabric or upholstery, and a signature is present below the object toward the right side, reading "C. BOWMAN."
title: Stool
